{{Quote|This is our recreation of the beloved childhood favorite, prepared with freshly ground ettel nuts and gourmet Andorian jelly. Served on bleached pseudograin bread.|The menu at Dex's description of the deluxe nutmeat and jelly sandwich|<ref name="DaD" />}}
'''Andorian jelly''' was an ingredient used in cooking during the reign of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. It was used in two dishes served at the [[Restaurant/Legends|eatery]] known as [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the [[deluxe nutmeat and jelly sandwich]] and a breakfast side in which it was spread on [[Mustafarian toast]].

==History==
It was used as part of two dishes served at the [[Restaurant/Legends|eatery]] known as [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] located in the [[CoCo Town/Legends|CoCo Town]] [[district]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and run by the [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] [[Chef/Legends|chef]] [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster's]]. The first dish consisted of the jelly spread on [[Mustafarian toast]] with [[Bantha butter/Legends|Bantha butter]], and was sold as a breakfast side dish for 1.7 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. The second was the [[deluxe nutmeat and jelly sandwich]], which was a recreation of a dish favored in some patrons' childhoods and consisted of ground [[ettel nut]]s and a gourmet make of the jelly spread on bleached [[pseudograin bread]]. The [[Sandwich/Legends|sandwich]] was sold as a lunch dish for 4.5 credits and both it and the breakfast side were served at Dex's<ref name="DaD" /> prior to its destruction in around [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]].<ref name="Underworld">''[[The Last of the Jedi: Underworld]]''</ref> [[Ando/Legends|Ando]] was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="A:PotWM">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20030703ando|text=Ando: Planet of the Walrus Men|int=Ando: Planet of the Walrus Men}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Andorian jelly was first mentioned in the [[Tales of the Jedi (audio drama)|audio drama]] based on the [[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi (miniseries)|''Tales of the Jedi'']] and ''[[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – The Freedon Nadd Uprising|Tales of the Jedi: The Freedon Nadd Uprising]]'' [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] series. The comics, which made no mention of the jelly, were written by [[Tom Veitch]] while the audiodrama was written by [[John Whitman]]. The jelly later received another mention in the [[2009]] [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] exclusive article, "[[Dining at Dex's]]," which was written by [[Gregory Walker]]. Neither source makes clear the connection between the jelly and Ando.
